secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.intro: Secrets of this installation: OIDC client secrets, repository tokens, service credentials. A value is encrypted in the database and never shown again; other screens select a secret by name.

create.neverShownAgain: The value will never be displayed again, not even to you.

cultures.title: Cultures
cultures.intro: Every culture already exists; activate the ones this installation uses. Active cultures are offered wherever a value is entered per culture.
cultures.keepValues: Deactivating a culture deletes nothing: values entered for it are kept and come back if it is reactivated.

oidc.title: OIDC connectors
oidc.intro: Each active connector becomes a sign-in button. Connectors are declared for the whole installation; their client secret is chosen among the declared secrets.

form.checkedOnSave: On save, the provider is queried to check that it answers as an OIDC provider.

form.manageAssociationsGrants: When checked, identities of this directory can be associated with an identity carrying the same address, proposed by one account and accepted by the other within seven days.

security.title: Root security service
security.intro: The security service (Keycloak) authenticates portal users and also the terminals of every workspace: if it is unavailable, no terminal starts. One service for the installation; workspaces reference it.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: One workspace per business application, with its git repository. Before creating it, Miles really tries the five rights it needs on the repository.

form.title: New workspace
form.writesForReal: The test writes for real: it creates the branch and tag {{branch}}, pushes a commit, then removes both. On an empty repository, Miles first creates the branch main.
form.testing: Testing the five rights with the branch {{branch}}…
